rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something of poor quality or disappointing standard, including something that is inadequate.

example.english: This hotel is so lousy, and they still charge so much—it’s outrageous.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店咁差，仲要收咁貴，真係離譜。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 gam3 caa1 zung6 jiu3 sau1 gam3 gwai3 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2

rows.note: Use this when “lousy” means that someone feels physically unwell or under the weather.

example.english: I feel lousy today and don’t want to go out.
example.traditional: 我今日個人唔舒服，唔想出街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 go3 jan4 m4 syu1 fuk6 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when “lousy” describes a place or thing as dirty or untidy rather than generally poor in quality.

example.english: That toilet is so lousy and dirty that I really don’t want to go in.
example.traditional: 間廁所污糟到，我真係唔想入去。
example.jyutping: gaan1 ci3 so2 wu1 zou1 dou3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 jap6 heoi3
